Long, straight platinum-white hair tied into a low ponytail. Narrow, cold ice-blue eyes. Appears in mid-twenties with a stoic, refined maturity. Slender, poised build. Wears a traditional white and light-blue modified cheongsam with silver embroidery and flowing wide sleeves. Features a decorative traditional hair pin and a long, flowing white silk sash.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
